name: spec_rfc_process

states.label: Draft
states.description: Under discussion; not yet ready for review.

states.label: Accepted
states.description: Approved, but not necessarily applied yet.

states.label: Implemented
states.description: Accepted and applied to active spec artifacts.

states.label: Superseded
states.description: Replaced by a later RFC or decision.

transitions.name: propose
transitions.description: Put a draft up for community review.

transitions.name: revise
transitions.description: Send a proposal back for further drafting.

transitions.name: implement
transitions.description: Apply the accepted change to active spec artifacts.

transitions.name: supersede
transitions.description: Replace an accepted-but-not-yet-implemented RFC with a successor.

transitions.name: supersede
transitions.description: Replace an implemented RFC with a successor.

transitions.name: withdraw
transitions.description: Withdraw a draft without putting it up for review.

transitions.name: withdraw
transitions.description: Withdraw a proposal without accepting it.

transitions.name: withdraw
transitions.description: Withdraw an accepted RFC before implementation.

description: The RFC process lifecycle: draft under discussion, proposed for community review, accepted for implementation, implemented and applied to active spec artifacts. rejected, superseded, and withdrawn are off-ramps. Governed by rfc-decision-43249f53 (one state mechanism — workflow status is a Lifecycle, not a bare select field). Shared by the rfc and rfc-decision Types.
